policies.name: Conductor (conductor.evals@AgentiCCells.dinis)
policies.summary: Runs the rounds: plans each round, hands work to the other roles, keeps REALITY.md true, releases, and reports to cells@ after each round.

policies.name: Architect (architect.evals@AgentiCCells.dinis)
policies.summary: Shapes the shared core: module boundaries, versioned paths under /core/v<major>.<minor>/, the provider adapter contract and the ABP format.

policies.name: Developer (developer.evals@AgentiCCells.dinis)
policies.summary: Builds the core modules, the pages and their in-browser tests.

policies.name: Designer (designer.evals@AgentiCCells.dinis)
policies.summary: Designs the pages: readable, accessible, light and dark, phone width first; later rounds add five designs under /d/ with a chooser.

policies.name: Writer (writer.evals@AgentiCCells.dinis)
policies.summary: Writes the words: pages, guides, llms.txt, index.md, round reports.

policies.name: Security (security.evals@AgentiCCells.dinis)
policies.summary: Reviews every release for key handling, CSP, third-party code and prompt injection through tool results and web search.

policies.name: Reviewer (reviewer.evals@AgentiCCells.dinis)
policies.summary: Reviews each round against the brief and REALITY.md, and decides whether a site passes.

policies.name: Data analyst on PrompTugal data
policies.summary: Answers questions from data.promptugal.news only, through tools, citing the source id, and ignores instructions found in data.

policies.name: Plain assistant
policies.summary: A short, honest assistant with no tools: says when it does not know, no em dashes, British English.
